operational: Each distinct 301-sample physical column is an observation. Use exactly reversed U for donor fitting and original F for held prefix issuance. Normalize q=(x−stored LowerBoundary)/(stored UpperBoundary−stored LowerBoundary). Actual U pilot medians start near1.2 and end below0; reversals therefore point toward increasing q. Preselected snippet and its 301 samples are known, so only archived processed-window transfer is tested.

comparison: Per acquisition-metadata stratum, unweighted empirical nearest-neighbor CDFs from reversed U donors. Issue clock state = q at issuance + normalized issue time + reached threshold flag and sensor current dt/stratum. Short-history baseline adds latest 8 us displacement slope. Candidate adds elapsed time since visit to q<=.2 and mean position over last 32us relative to current q. Fixed k64; compare k16,64,256 state-only and short-history controls, plus history-shuffled64 and no-history donor prior. Frozen physical horizons, deterministic robust coordinate scales from U donors only. No event-level IID p-values. Offline conditioning on archived successful-transition selection.
metrics: For each strictly observed eligible physical path, average the seven squared CDF errors, bounded by 1. Preserve every absent or partial record with score bounds [0,1] and paired differences [−1,1]. Mean within each source stratum, then mean across observed strata within each hairpin; summary equal mean over three hairpins and worst hairpin. Candidate must strictly beat the best aggregate among the six same-state/short-history variants on both mean and worst, and beat the shuffled-history comparator on both. The 4 gates concern actual present scoreable paths only. Also report all individual curves/strata, worst stratum and full unknown-count sensitivity including missing metadata stratum under 620 declared. No held parameter search. No implication of unique molecular mechanism.
